fact: The standards body's information-technology catalogue lists ISO 15836:2009 (Dublin Core metadata element set), ISO 15489-1:2001 and ISO 16175-1:2010 (records management) as SZNS national standards; the catalogue is undated, so the retrieval-date proxy 2026-08-29 is used.
The standards body launched SZNS ISO 19160-1:2015 and ISO 19160-2:2022 (addressing) as the Eswatini National Addressing Standards.
